_meta.full_name: HOMI TECHNOLOGIES LLC — Decision Readiness Intelligence™
_meta.stack: Next.js 15 + React 19 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS v4 + Supabase + Stripe + Plaid + Anthropic
_meta.authority: Executable TypeScript in this repo wins over this document. Prefer lib/scoring, lib/brand, lib/agents/registry on conflict.

db_tables.name: finance_savings_goals
db_tables.description: Savings goals ledger (replaces legacy goals table)

ai_agents.name: Homie
ai_agents.boundary: Never pressures conversion. Never suggests paid actions.
ai_agents.description: Your warm, direct coordinator. Homie listens first, then pulls in the right specialist when your question needs one.

ai_agents.name: Scout
ai_agents.boundary: Presents alternatives, never picks for you.
ai_agents.description: Discovers context and patterns in the user's readiness data — market awareness, life transitions, and things they might have missed.

ai_agents.name: Analyst
ai_agents.boundary: Educational math only. No product advice.
ai_agents.description: Deep-dives into the financial metrics. Explains DTI, runway, affordability, and opportunity costs in plain language.

ai_agents.name: Coach
ai_agents.boundary: Not a therapist. Identifies but does not treat.
ai_agents.description: Builds the emotional and motivational side of the decision — pressure, clarity, fear, FOMO, and what 'ready' actually feels like.

ai_agents.name: Architect
ai_agents.description: Designs the decision roadmap: what to fix, in what order, and how long it realistically takes to move from NOT YET to READY.

ai_agents.name: Oracle
ai_agents.description: Runs scenario analysis and stress tests — what happens if income drops, rates rise, or timing shifts.

ai_agents.name: Sentinel
ai_agents.boundary: Cannot be bypassed. Monitors all interactions for safety and compliance.
ai_agents.description: Always active safety layer. Blocks disallowed advice, pressure language, and any attempt to bypass HōMI's educational-only posture.

gaps.issue: Playwright E2E covers core funnels but not the full product matrix
gaps.fix: Expand specs surgically for money/auth/share; keep live specs gated on secrets

gaps.issue: PostHog events are not instrumented uniformly across product routes
gaps.fix: Align capture calls to BUILD-BRIEF taxonomy (assessment_*, verdict_*, checkout_*)

gaps.issue: Verdict vocabulary is dual-stable: enum NOT_YET, badge DO NOT PROCEED, prose often says “not yet”
gaps.fix: Keep Policy A (see docs/adr/001-verdict-vocabulary.md); do not rename the enum without a migration ADR

scoring_engine.description: Deterministic code-only scoring (lib/scoring/engine.ts). AI explains only, never calculates.
scoring_engine.vocabulary_note: Storage/API enum is NOT_YET; user-facing badge label is DO NOT PROCEED; calm prose may still say “not yet.” See docs/adr/001-verdict-vocabulary.md.

brand.voice: Calm, clear, warm, honest. Never fear-based. Never hype.

positioning.never_say: HōMI replaces your credit score or professional advice
positioning.always_say: HōMI is an educational readiness layer, not a replacement for professional advice

compliance.disclaimer: HōMI is a product of HOMI TECHNOLOGIES LLC. HōMI is not a lender, mortgage broker, registered investment advisor, credit bureau, real estate agent or brokerage, financial planner, bank or deposit institution, or product recommendation engine. HōMI provides educational guidance only and does not provide financial, legal, tax, mortgage, real estate, or investment advice.
compliance.positioning: Readiness layer — never a credit score replacement

protocol: Fetch architecture.json from the product domain (homitechnology.com), not third-party mirrors.
If _meta.generated is stale or architecture:check would fail, refuse to plan from the feed alone.
For scoring, verdicts, and agent levels: open lib/* when the feed disagrees.
Treat gaps[].severity as a hint; verify each issue in the repo before scheduling work.
Never emit calculator paths that are not in calculators[].route.
Never copy non-canon hex colors into product code — brand-check bans the orange/red Tailwind defaults.
